core.title: Schlage Thick Door Extension Kit for Keypad Deadbolts
tags: SCH-02-007 Schlage Keypad Deadbolt Thick Door Extension Kit

text.description_html:
Schlage Keypad Deadbolt Thick Door Extension Kit

This extension kit allows keypad deadbolts to be used on 1-7/8" - 2-1/2" thick doors and gates. For use with Schlage Keypad deadbolts

Kit includes extra long tail piece and screws.

*Sold Individually
